legend: The sheep are fleeing from the wolf that has entered their pasture. To save themselves, they must escape through fenced paths designated for sheep shearing. The paths are connected to each other and eventually lead to a single exit into the farmyard, where the sheep that escape the wolf will be safe. The paths are arranged in a special formation, consisting of several segments of the same shape, with each segment containing 5 paths. The entry point of each segment, except for the first, is also the exit point of the previous segment.

The entry point of the first segment is in the pasture, and the exit point of the last segment leads into the farmyard. The sheep always run in the same direction along one path, and it never happens that two sheep run along the same path in opposite directions. The sheep cannot jump over the fence of the path. The sheep's escape is further complicated by the fact that halfway along each path there is an automatic gate that allows a certain number of sheep to pass through before closing itself, making the path impassable for other sheep. However, the wolf can jump over the gates on the paths, making him extremely dangerous. We assume (and the sheep assume as well) that the wolf can catch only those sheep which are no longer able to reach the farmyard due to the closed gates.
Determine how many sheep can escape from the wolf at most, given that for each gate it is known how many sheep it will let through.
The diagram shows the paths arranged in a formation of 4 segments.
input: The first input line contains a single integer N$$$N$$$ (1≤N≤105)$$$(1 \leq N \leq 10^{5})$$$, the number of segments in the path formation. Each of the next N$$$N$$$ lines contains 5 space separated integers Ai,Bi,Ci,Di,Ei$$$A_{i}, B_{i}, C_{i}, D_{i}, E_{i}$$$ (1≤Ai,Bi,Ci,Di,Ei≤108)$$$(1 \leq A_{i}, B_{i}, C_{i}, D_{i}, E_{i} \leq 10^{8})$$$, the numbers of sheep which can pass through the corresponding gate in the i$$$i$$$-th segment before the gate closes. The letters A,B,C,D,E$$$A, B, C, D, E$$$ correspond to the notation in the image above. Segments are linked in the same order as they appear in the input. The entry of the first segment is in the pasture, the last segment leads into the farmyard.
output: Output a single integer, the maximum number of sheep which can escape the wolf.

legend.ai: 这些羊正在逃离进入牧场的狼。为了自救，它们必须通过为剪羊毛而设的围栏通道逃跑。通道彼此相连，最终通向农场院子中的一个出口，成功逃离狼的羊在那里将是安全的。通道以一种特殊的形态排列，由若干个形状相同的段组成，每段包含 5 条通道。除第一段外，每一段的入口点也是上一段的出口点。

第一段的入口点位于牧场中，最后一段的出口点通向农场院子。羊总是沿着某条通道朝同一方向奔跑，且不会出现两只羊沿同一条通道朝相反方向奔跑的情况。羊无法跳过通道的围栏。羊的逃生更加复杂，因为每条通道的中途都有一道自动闸门，允许一定数量的羊通过后便自动关闭，使该通道对其他羊无法通行。然而，狼可以跳过通道上的闸门，这使它极其危险。我们假设（羊也这样认为），狼只能抓住那些由于闸门关闭而再也无法到达农场院子的羊。
在已知每个闸门允许通过的羊的数量的情况下，求最多有多少只羊能够逃脱狼的追捕。
图中展示了由 4 个路段组成的路径布局。

input.ai: 第一行输入包含一个整数 N$$$N$$$ (1≤N≤105)$$$(1 \leq N \leq 10^{5})$$$，表示路径布局中的路段数量。接下来的 N$$$N$$$ 行每行包含 5 个以空格分隔的整数 Ai,Bi,Ci,Di,Ei$$$A_{i}, B_{i}, C_{i}, D_{i}, E_{i}$$$ (1≤Ai,Bi,Ci,Di,Ei≤108)$$$(1 \leq A_{i}, B_{i}, C_{i}, D_{i}, E_{i} \leq 10^{8})$$$，表示在闸门关闭之前，第 i$$$i$$$ 个路段中相应闸门允许通过的羊的数量。字母 A、B、C、D、E$$$A, B, C, D, E$$$ 对应于上图中的标注。各路段按照它们在输入中出现的顺序连接。第一个路段的入口位于牧场，最后一个路段通向农场院。

output.ai: 输出一个整数，即能够逃脱狼的羊的最大数量。
